tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Be Sew Bizzy's products (quilt fabric, notions, patterns, embroidery supplies) by name, maker, collection, color or SKU. Returns ids to pass to fetch for price, sale, stock and colors.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full details of one product by the id search returned: price, sale price, per-yard or each, stock, every color and the description.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the shop's products by name, maker, collection, color or SKU — every word must match. Returns price, sale price, whether it's per yard, stock, colors and the product url.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product by its slug (from search results): description, price, sale price, and every color with its SKU and stock.

tools.name: list_classes
tools.description: Upcoming class and event sessions at the shop, soonest first, with date, time, price, instructor and url.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: The shop's posted opening hours and whether it is open right now.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
